title: Close-up of an extrusion head and stepper motor depositing brown material on parchment
objects_and_counts: One extrusion head assembly is visible near the center of the image; it includes a small nozzle/dispenser that is illuminated pink and a larger squared metal housing immediately to its right.
One stepper motor (silver end caps with black ribbed central section) is visible to the right of the metal housing.
One small plastic syringe-like dispenser or nozzle is visible to the left of the metal housing; it has a small white connector and yellow/white wires attached and is lit with a pink light.

Two continuous parallel brown extrusion lines of deposited material run from the top of the image toward the bottom across the parchment; both lines are visibly continuous and distinct in the photographed region.
A third, irregular brown extrusion area (a looped/ornamented deposit) is visible immediately under the nozzle area.
One blue binder clip is partially visible at the lower-left corner of the image; it is clipped to the parchment edge and only the top portion is visible (cropped).
One silver metal clip (paper/binder-style) is visible to the left of the blue clip; it is partially cropped by the image edge.
One work surface covered with light-grey parchment or baking paper is visible; the parchment shows stains and a pale printed motif or mark near the center-bottom of the image.
